high_level_description: This image is the cover of Vogue Hong Kong's May 2021 issue. The central figure is Kendall Jenner, who is seated on a large, light-colored, scalloped shell-like object that resembles a clamshell. She is dressed in a form-fitting, black, textured jumpsuit with long sleeves and matching black sandals. Her hair is long, straight, and dark, cascading down her back. Kendall is accessorized with large, gold hoop earrings and a gold bracelet on her right wrist. She holds a small, gold clutch in her left hand. The overall mood of the image is elegant and sophisticated
